items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: I listen to Mutt as much as I have anybody else.

ctx.x: Because that guy, he was in every chorus, he varies his tone.

Yeah, I can't, and his phrasing too. Yeah, there's a guy that I think is extremely underrated. I talked to some of the Whiteman, and he said, oh he has such a bad tone. Well, Mutt's tone wasn't like the other guys, but it was hot. And his phrasing was excellent, and he could really finger that instrument too, you know. Yeah, Mutt was just great. Well, I think that many of the white guys don't like vibrato. I love vibrato, and I love Mutt. Mutt had a very wide vibrato. Yeah, I've always liked Mutt. I think Mutt…
You listen to them, you know that they really study it.
